title: timeAgo
responsibility: Formats relative dates. Commit dates can request numeric wording such as one week ago.

inputs.name: timeAgo.value
inputs.description: Timestamp string parsed by Date.parse() and subtracted from now in milliseconds. Invalid timestamps return an empty string; future timestamps and elapsed times under 60,000 milliseconds return "just now".

inputs.name: timeAgo.now
inputs.description: Reference epoch time in milliseconds used to compute elapsed time from value. Defaults to Date.now() when omitted; non-finite elapsed calculations return an empty string.

inputs.name: timeAgo.numeric
inputs.description: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat numeric mode applied to valid elapsed ages of at least one minute. Defaults to "auto"; the accepted values are "auto" and "always", and "always" requests numeric phrasing.

outputs.name: timeAgo
outputs.description: English relative-age text for a parseable timestamp and finite elapsed time. Elapsed times below 60,000 milliseconds, including future timestamps, return "just now"; larger ages use the first matching threshold (365 days per year, 30 days per month, then week, day, hour, or minute) with whole units.
